evals.prompt: Add a Binary Tree maze generation algorithm to the maze-builder library. Wire it up so it works end to end, including a demo page card.
evals.expected_output: A new BinaryTreeGenerator class implementing IMazeGenerator in src/algorithms/binary-tree.ts; Algorithm.BINARY_TREE added to the enum in src/types.ts; class imported and registered in src/index.ts GENERATORS record; tests covering dimensions, connectivity, and determinism; a demo card added to index.html with data-algo matching the enum string value.

assertions.text: src/algorithms/binary-tree.ts is created and exports a BinaryTreeGenerator class
Algorithm.BINARY_TREE = 'binary-tree' is added to the enum in src/types.ts
BinaryTreeGenerator is registered in the GENERATORS record in src/index.ts
A test file covers the binary tree algorithm (dimensions, connectivity, determinism)
index.html has a demo card with data-algo="binary-tree"
pnpm build passes with no type errors
Time and space complexity are documented in comments/JSDoc
No DOM/framework imports (document, window, canvas, React) in src/algorithms/binary-tree.ts
